name: bash-feed
description: Streams each Bash command Claude runs, with color-coded output and short explanations, to a per-session Terminal window

teacherLevel.title: Explanations
teacherLevel.description: How much the teacher explains each command: beginner (every part), intermediate (only less common programs and flags), or off (no explanations and no Haiku calls).

language.title: Explanation language
language.description: The language the explanations and plain-English line are written in.

explainer.title: Explanation layout
explainer.description: collapsed: show the warning and the plain-English line, with the part-by-part explanation behind a ⌘-click link. expanded: show every part in the window.

showWhy.title: Show why line
showWhy.description: Show Claude's one-line reason above each command, as a # comment.

showSummary.title: Show plain-English line
showSummary.description: Show the green one-sentence summary after each command's explanation.

showRisk.title: Show risk warnings
showRisk.description: Show a red warning line for commands that delete, overwrite, push, use sudo or send data out.

showFileChanges.title: Show file changes
showFileChanges.description: Show Claude's file edits (Edit, Write, notebook edits) with their diffs.

commandLines.title: Command lines shown
commandLines.description: Lines of a long command shown before the rest is linked (⌘-click to read it all).

outputRows.title: Output rows per command
outputRows.description: Screen rows of output shown per command, wrapped lines included; the rest is saved and linked.

diffRows.title: Diff rows per file change
diffRows.description: Screen rows of each file change's diff shown; the rest is saved and linked.

openOnStart.title: Open window at session start
openOnStart.description: Open the feed window behind Claude when a session starts. Off: open it with /bash-feed window.

retentionDays.title: Keep logs for (days)
retentionDays.description: Session logs and saved long outputs older than this are deleted when a session starts. 0 keeps them forever.
